parsed.faithful: SWORD, an offensive weapon worn at the fide, and fer- ving either to cut or ftab. Its parts are, the handle, guard, and blade; to which may be added the bow, feabbard, pum- mel, &c.
parsed.modern: SWORD, an offensive weapon worn at the side, and serving either to cut or stab. Its parts are, the handle, guard, and blade; to which may be added the bow, scabbard, pommel, &c.
